sloka: उत्तरस्याम् पुर द्वारि व्यादिzय zउक सारणौ ।स्वयम् च अत्र भविष्यामि मन्त्रिणस् तान् उवाच ह ॥६-३६-१९॥।।
transliteration: uttarasyām pura dvāri vyādizya zuka sāraṇau ।svayam ca atra bhaviṣyāmi mantriṇas tān uvāca ha ॥6-36-19॥।।

translations.english: Ravana posted Suka and Sarana at the north gate of Lanka and himself reached there and told the ministers that he would be there.
